question: In ∆ABC and ∆PQR, AB = PQ and ∠B = ∠Q. The two triangles are congruent by SAS criteria if:
solution:
Given:

AB = PQ

∠B = ∠Q

Formula used:

SAS rule is the two side of the triangle is equal and the angle made by these side is also equal

Calculations:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/d222e48c70018eb293f3512682f091415c0bfc2e67fde5bee894a6020edfba84.png] 

According to the question,

In ∆ABC and ∆PQR

⇒ AB = PQ

⇒ ∠B = ∠Q

So, angle B is made the side AB and BC and angle Q is made up by the side PQ and QR

So, BC must be equal to QR to make these two triangle congruent by SAS rule

**⇒ ****Hence, Option (1) is correct**
